info.name: eo-be Phase 4-5
info.description:
Collection test Phase 4 (auth/user) + Phase 5 (skill/topic/exam/card/admin).

Cach dung:
1. Import file nay + eo-be.local.postman_environment.json
2. Chon environment eo-be local
3. Dam bao BE dang chay o http://localhost:8080
4. Chay theo thu tu: Login admin -> Skill header -> Create exam -> Create card

Admin seed: admin@toeic.local / Admin@123
OTP va reset code in ra console BE, khong gui Gmail.
Cac API create/update/delete skill-topic-exam-card can ROLE_ADMIN.
Khong chay Delete tren data seed (Part 1-7) neu khong muon mat data mau.

request.description: Chay request nay truoc. Token duoc luu vao {{token}}.
OTP in console BE. Copy OTP vao {{otp}} roi goi Verify OTP truoc khi login user moi.
Sua email cho khop user vua register. OTP lay tu log BE.
Giu nguyen password admin de test tiep. Doi neu muon thu that.
Reset code in console BE (Temporary password for ...). Gan vao {{resetCode}}.
Khong can JWT. Tra Listening/Reading + Part 1-7. Luu id seed vao bien.
Chi xoa skill vua tao, khong xoa Listening/Reading.
topicId lay tu Skill header. Exam se duoc append vao topic.examIds.
Chay sau khi da test xong card. Soft-delete exam vua tao.
Card duoc append vao exam.cardIds. Dung Create exam truoc.
